project.title: Cross-Sell Playbook for Hospitality Tech Clients
project.objective: Design and roll out a structured cross-sell and upsell playbook for hospitality tech customers to increase revenue and improve guest experience.
deliverables: Segmented account list with cross-sell potential scoring
Standardized cross-sell call and email scripts
Pilot results summary and iteration plan
constraints: Playbook must be usable by both day and night shift staff
No changes to core billing or PMS systems in this phase
All outreach must comply with data protection and opt-in rules
Initial pilot limited to existing hospitality customers only
Playbook must be trainable in under 2 hours per user

risks.risk: Sales team does not consistently adopt the new playbook.
risks.mitigation: Involve reps in design, keep scripts lightweight, add quick reference checklist and track usage.

risks.risk: Night shift constraints make cross-sell offers feel intrusive to guests.
risks.mitigation: Co-design guest-friendly timing and scripts with night auditor and limit offers to relevant touchpoints.

risks.risk: Data quality issues in existing customer records reduce targeting accuracy.
risks.mitigation: Run a one-time data clean-up on pilot accounts and add a simple data-completeness checklist for reps.

risks.risk: Offers conflict with existing promotions managed by marketing.
risks.mitigation: Align offer matrix with current campaigns and set a simple approval rule for new bundles.

themes.why_relevant: Core to deciding which customers and guest moments to target for additional offers.
Ensures reps and night staff use consistent, effective messaging with minimal friction.
Accurate records are needed to track outreach, follow-ups, and pilot results.
Offers must not degrade guest satisfaction, especially during night shifts.
Team needs a simple way to review what worked and refine the playbook quickly.

backlog.task: Define hospitality customer segments and cross-sell scoring criteria
definition_of_done: Segmentation criteria documented and agreed in channel
Top 30 pilot accounts tagged with segment and score
Assumptions and data sources listed in the doc

backlog.task: Draft initial cross-sell call and email scripts for pilot
definition_of_done: At least two variants of call script and one email template drafted
Scripts reviewed by at least one other rep
Objections and suggested responses captured in notes

backlog.task: Map guest journey touchpoints suitable for cross-sell by shift
definition_of_done: List of key guest touchpoints for day and night shifts created
Each touchpoint labeled as low, medium, or high suitability
Constraints for night offers (noise, timing, sensitivity) documented

backlog.task: Create offer matrix linking products to guest scenarios
definition_of_done: Matrix lists core products and 3–5 common guest scenarios
Recommended bundles and talking points filled in
Checked for conflicts with current promotions

backlog.task: Design simple CRM fields and tags to track cross-sell activities
definition_of_done: List of required fields and tags documented
Usage examples for at least three scenarios included
Validated that fields can be added without system changes

backlog.task: Prepare quick-reference checklist for night shift cross-sell
definition_of_done: Checklist fits on a single page
Includes do/don't rules and escalation steps
Reviewed and approved by at least one sales representative

backlog.task: Align playbook with compliance and data protection rules
definition_of_done: Data usage and opt-in requirements summarized
Scripts updated to include consent language where needed
Compliance notes added to playbook document

backlog.task: Plan and schedule pilot rollout with selected accounts
definition_of_done: Pilot account list finalized and shared
Start and end dates agreed in channel
Owners assigned for each pilot account

backlog.task: Collect pilot feedback from reps and night staff
definition_of_done: Feedback from at least three shifts captured
Common issues and positive patterns summarized
Suggestions for script and process tweaks listed

backlog.task: Compile pilot performance summary and next-step proposal
definition_of_done: Basic metrics (contacts, offers, accepts) summarized
Key learnings and 3–5 changes proposed
Recommendation on scaling or extending pilot documented

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on scope, segments, and pilot account list for the cross-sell playbook.
threads_plan.trigger: Kickoff message announcing the project and asking for input on target segments.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree on final segmentation criteria and scoring approach for pilot accounts.
Confirm the list of pilot hospitality accounts and owners in A1.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Co-create and finalize scripts, offer matrix, and guest touchpoints.
threads_plan.trigger: Share first draft of A2 and ask for comments from reps and night auditor.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Lock in the initial call and email scripts for the pilot.
Approve the guest journey touchpoints and offer matrix for day and night shifts.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Define CRM tracking, compliance guardrails, and activity logging.
threads_plan.trigger: Question on how to tag and track cross-sell activities without system changes.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree on the minimal set of CRM fields and tags to use for the pilot.
Confirm that scripts and process comply with data protection guidelines.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Run the pilot, share quick updates, and capture live feedback.
threads_plan.trigger: Announcement that the pilot is starting with a reminder of key rules.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Decide how frequently to post pilot updates and what metrics to share in-channel.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Review pilot results and agree on next steps for scaling or iterating.
threads_plan.trigger: Post-pilot summary message sharing early numbers and asking for a go/no-go on scaling.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Decide whether to scale the playbook, extend the pilot, or pause for more changes.

channel_rituals: Async kickoff post summarizing goals, scope, and initial tasks with emoji reactions for alignment.
Twice-weekly async standup where each person posts what they did, next steps, and blockers.
Weekly pilot check-in thread reviewing A4 metrics and quick qualitative notes.
End-of-pilot retro thread capturing wins, issues, and top three changes to the playbook.
